description: This file defines a ConfigStore utility for managing application configuration data, supporting remote and local storage mechanisms, with capabilities for overriding behaviors during testing.

classes.name: OverrideStore
classes.description: An actor class to hold and modify override configurations for testing purposes.

methods.name: isRemoteMode
methods.description: Determines whether the app is in remote mode, considering overrides or the current app state.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads configuration data, either from remote via gateway or local storage.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves configuration data, either remotely or locally, with override support.

methods.name: loadFromGateway
methods.description: Fetches configuration from remote gateway, updating internal state.

methods.name: saveToGateway
methods.description: Saves configuration to remote gateway, using hashing to optimize updates.

methods.name: _testSetOverrides
methods.description: Test utility to set override configurations during debugging.

methods.name: _testClearOverrides
methods.description: Test utility to clear override configurations during debugging.
